overview:
Meet Rwanda's two most famous primates in just two days. This 2 days gorilla and golden monkey trekking safari takes you to Volcanoes National Park for an unforgettable hour with a mountain gorilla family, followed the next morning by a lively encounter with the rare golden monkeys of the Virunga bamboo forests. In the afternoon of your gorilla day, you will visit the Gorilla Guardians Village, where local dancers, drummers and storytellers share Rwandan traditions. With a private 4x4, your own driver guide and a comfortable lodge near the park, this short safari delivers Rwanda's highlights without rushing.

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

This short escape is luxury gorilla trekking Rwanda style: a comfortable private transfer from Kigali, a night at an elegant lodge overlooking the Virunga volcanoes and a once-in-a-lifetime hour with a mountain gorilla family. After a leisurely lunch in Kigali, you drive north to your lodge to unwind with fireplaces, fine food and attentive service. The next morning, you step into Volcanoes National Park for your trek, returning in the afternoon for an evening flight. It is designed for travellers who want Rwanda's greatest wildlife encounter with comfort, privacy and minimal time away.

This golden monkey and Bisoke hike tour is a fantastic Volcanoes National Park adventure without the cost of a gorilla permit. You will start with a Kigali city tour and a visit to the Kigali Genocide Memorial, then head north to Musanze.

Day two is all about the Mount Bisoke hike, climbing through bamboo and moss-covered forest to a stunning crater lake on the summit. On your final morning, you will trek to a troop of playful golden monkeys before returning to Kigali.

Give yourself time to truly enjoy Nyungwe on this 3-day Nyungwe Forest National Park tour. One of Africa's oldest rainforests, Nyungwe is home to chimpanzees, huge troops of Angola colobus monkeys and over 300 bird species. You will stop at the King's Palace Museum in Nyanza on the way, try your hand at tea picking, track chimpanzees at dawn, walk the canopy bridge high above the trees and finish with a colobus monkey trek. The relaxed pace makes it ideal for primate lovers, photographers and birders who want more than a quick visit.

This Akagera and Nyungwe safari brings together Rwanda's savannah and rainforest in just four days. Start in Akagera National Park with a sunset boat cruise on Lake Ihema and a full-day game drive in search of the Big Five. Then head southwest to Nyungwe Forest National Park, where you will cross the famous canopy walkway and track chimpanzees in one of Africa's oldest forests. With a private 4x4 and your own Divulge Adventures driver guide, it is a great-value way to see two very different sides of Rwanda, and a perfect choice if gorilla permits are sold out.

This 7 days Rwanda primate safari gives you time to enjoy every highlight without rushing. In Nyungwe Forest National Park, you will track chimpanzees at dawn, walk the canopy bridge and pick tea on emerald hillsides.

Then you will travel north to Volcanoes National Park for your Rwanda primate safari mountain gorilla trek, a cultural afternoon with the Gorilla Guardians, a golden monkey trek and a peaceful canoe trip on the Mukungwa River. With a Kigali city tour and a stop at the King's Palace in Nyanza, it is a rich mix of wildlife, culture and countryside, ideal for first-time visitors.
